تلاقيت (form VI)
# تَلَاقَيْتُ (talāqaytu) /ta.laː.qaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَلَاقَى (talāqā)
# تَلَاقَيْتَ (talāqayta) /ta.laː.qaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَلَاقَى (talāqā)
# تَلَاقَيْتِ (talāqayti) /ta.laː.qaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَلَاقَى (talāqā)
